description: D-68 (iii): does the answer follow the spelling register of the question, in words of its own? Five British-spelled questions, five American-spelled, pairwise identical apart from spelling. Each question carries one cue word (colour/color, organise/organize, centre/center, grey/gray, recognise/recognize) and asks for something whose natural answer uses OTHER register-marked words (a measurement in metres/meters or kilometres/kilometers, a colour/color). Scored by app/spelling.py on NOVEL marked words only - marked words in the answer that the question did not contain in either spelling - so echoing the cue back scores nothing. FOLLOWED: every novel marked word is in the question's register and there is at least one; MIXED: both registers; OPPOSED: all in the other register; UNSCORED: no novel marked word (a small model's usual result). Headline = FOLLOWED / scored, with the unscored count and the echo-inclusive score shown beside it. Disjoint from sft/spelling_seed.jsonl.
scoring: novel-words-only verdict per item; headline = followed / (10 - unscored), unscored shown; echo-inclusive score reported beside it, never as the headline
